# Bonilla Tree Service LLC

> Licensed and insured tree service crew based in Jackson, Mississippi, working on homes and businesses across the Jackson metro. Owner-operated: the crew and the equipment are their own. Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Free estimates. English and Spanish.

## Key facts

- Business name: Bonilla Tree Service LLC
- Owner-operated (the crew and the equipment are the business's own)
- Founded: 2022
- Phone (call or text): 601-466-9145
- Email: bonillatreeservicesllc@gmail.com
- Website: https://bonillatreeservicellc.com/
- Base: Jackson, Mississippi (service-area business, no public storefront)
- Service area: Jackson, Ridgeland, Madison, Brandon, Pearl, Clinton, Flowood, Byram, Canton, Richland, Terry and Florence, MS
- Storm and disaster response: anywhere in the United States after a major storm
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week, including emergencies
- Licensed and insured, residential and commercial
- Languages: English, Spanish (se habla español)
- Estimates: free, firm price before any work starts
- Services (9): tree removal, tree trimming, pruning, stump grinding, lot clearing, land grading, tree planting, flower beds, fences
- Crew climbs trees (no bucket truck needed for tight backyards); wood, branches and stumps are hauled away
